title: Detonate the Maximum Bombs
goal: Find the largest chain reaction triggered by a single bomb.
strategy: Reach is directed: one bomb may cover another without being covered in return. Build edges with squared-distance comparisons, then explore the reachable set from each possible starting bomb.
